If you're looking for **smart lock installation in Altona North, VIC**, there are several well-reviewed locksmiths that install and configure smart locks (rather than just replacing traditional locks).

Some good local options include:

- Blackshaws Locksmith – Based in Altona North, offering locksmith services with extended daily hours.
- Altona Locksmiths – Established local locksmith servicing Altona North and surrounding suburbs, including electronic and keyless lock installations. [www.altonalocksmiths.com.au](https://www.altonalocksmiths.com.au/affordable-residential-locks-installation/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- Precision Locksmiths Melbourne – Mobile locksmith with experience installing a range of smart locking systems.
- AWARD LOCKSMITHS ALTONA – 24/7 mobile locksmith servicing the Altona area.

Typical installation costs in Melbourne are approximately:
- **A$150–A$250** if you're replacing an existing compatible deadbolt.
- **A$250–A$450+** if the door needs new holes, mortising, or significant modifications. [www.thespruce.com](https://www.thespruce.com/best-keyless-door-locks-11717779?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Before booking, it's worth checking:
- The **door thickness** and **backset** (common smart lock compatibility issues).
- Whether you already have the smart lock or want the locksmith to **supply and install** one.
- Whether the installer will also **set up the app, PINs, fingerprint access, and Wi-Fi/Bluetooth integration**.

If you haven't chosen a lock yet, I can also recommend models that work well in Australia, such as Yale, Lockly, Aqara, Philips, or Gainsborough, depending on your budget and whether you use Apple Home, Google Home, or Alexa.

sources.title: The 6 Best Smart Door Locks The Spruce Has Tested
sources.snippet:
The Spruce tested a range of smart door locks over six months to evaluate ease of use, security, installation, and compatibility with smart home systems. Topping their list is the Yale Assure Lock 2 Touch, praised for its sturdy build, reliable fingerprint scanner, and broad platform integration. It offers multiple entry methods and strong mobile app support. For those seeking a simpler, non-smart model, the Schlage Camelot Keypad Deadbolt is lauded for its traditional look, quality security, and straightforward code setup without internet connectivity.

Other top picks include the Kwikset Halo Touch, notable for its sleek design and fingerprint-focused access; the Yale Approach Lock, ideal for renters due to its retrofit design; and the Ultraloq U-Bolt Pro, which offers ANSI Grade 1 security and extensive smart features but requires a separate bridge for full functionality. The Yale Assure Lock SL excels in app integration despite lacking a fingerprint scanner.

Testing considerations included DIY setup, smart home compatibility, encryption, app effectiveness, and day-to-day usability. Standards from ANSI and BHMA were used to assess security grades. The guide emphasizes considering door compatibility, lock connectivity, and the reliability of customer service when selecting a lock.
